_comment: Single source of truth. Every number used by the simulator, live demo and dashboard is read from this file. Change a value, rerun `make year`, and every KPI updates.

weather_year.source: Open-Meteo historical weather API (ERA5-based archive), hourly temperature_2m, timezone Europe/Zurich

heating_day_threshold_c.source: DigitalHeat case: heating day = daily mean < 12 degC

space_heating_kwh_year.source: DigitalHeat case (~27,000 kWh over 206 heating days)

design_peak_kw.source: DigitalHeat case (~10 kW on a cold day) - used as a sanity check only

hot_water_shape.source: assumption; daily total fixed at 12 kWh

setback_temp_c.source: assumption: heating setback while the family is on holiday (frost/comfort protection)

away_hot_water_share.source: assumption: only legionella / circulation losses while away

tank_usable_kwh.source: DigitalHeat case (35 kWh usable, no losses)

reference_hardware.value: HPE ProLiant DL345 Gen12, 1x AMD EPYC 9375F + 4x NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell (32 GB)
reference_hardware.source: MLPerf Inference v6.1 results 6.1-0056 / 6.1-0114 (summary.xlsx). 4x200 W GPU + ~200 W host = ~1 kW class

idle_kw.source: assumption: paused servers are suspended (S3, a few W); counted as 0

capex_chf.source: assumption: 4x RTX PRO 4500 (~CHF 2,400 each, list price 2026) + 1U EPYC host (~CHF 2,400)

install_chf_per_house.source: assumption: water-cooled rack, heat exchanger, hydraulic connection to the existing tank

dry_cooler_chf.source: assumption: 10-15 kW dry cooler incl. installation - only needed by policies that dump heat

dry_cooler_fan_kwh_per_kwh.source: assumption: dry-cooler fan + pump energy (~3% of rejected heat)

discount_rate.source: assumption: cost of capital for annuity of capex

electricity_chf_per_kwh.source: ElCom 2026, IWB Industrielle Werke Basel, Basel (BFS 2701), category H4, total price 33.25 Rp/kWh, fetched from strompreis.elcom.admin.ch API

heat_pump_cop.source: DigitalHeat case: heat value = electricity price / 2.5

gpu_rental_low_chf_per_server_h.source: 4 consumer/prosumer Blackwell-class GPUs on spot marketplaces, ~USD 0.25-0.35 per GPU-h (vast.ai/runpod community-cloud, 2026 range)

gpu_rental_high_chf_per_server_h.source: 4x L4/RTX-6000-class on-demand, hyperscaler / Swiss sovereign cloud range ~USD 0.6-0.8 per GPU-h

sovereign_premium.source: assumption: Swiss-hosted, data-stays-in-CH premium vs. offshore spot

jobs_source.value: Job durations, GPU share and the daily arrival shape are resampled from the Alibaba PAI GPU trace 2020 (pai_task_table, ~6,500 GPUs, Jul-Aug 2020). Throughput/energy per job: MLPerf Inference v6.1 for the reference server; own measurements for the laptop demo jobs.

demand_factor.source: assumption: deadline (SLA) jobs sold = 60% of the fleet's yearly heat-matched capacity, flat over the year; sensitivity sweep 0.3-1.2 in results

backfill.source: Best-effort spot work without deadline (e.g. public-archive embedding, evaluation sweeps, rendering) fills any remaining heat budget. Always available on GPU spot markets.

spot_price_ratio.source: assumption: spot/backfill sells at ~50% of on-demand (typical cloud spot discount 50-70%)

electricity_by_site.source: ElCom 2026 H4 total price per BFS municipality, fetched live by scripts/fetch_data.py -> data/derived/elcom_sites_2026.json (Basel 33.25 ... Zermatt 22.32 Rp/kWh)

price_weight.source: dispatcher tie-break towards cheaper electricity. Tested at 0.05: no fleet cost effect, because backfill fills every heat budget anyway, so each site's electricity use is set by its heat demand. Regional prices therefore matter for per-site economics (see map), not for routing.

outages_per_site_year.source: assumption: residential internet / server faults (two events per site per year)

outage_hours.source: assumption: until a technician / ISP restores service

datacenter_pue.source: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2024: average PUE 1.56

grid_co2_g_per_kwh.source: assumption: Swiss consumer electricity mix incl. imports (order of magnitude of KBOB / BAFU values)

forecast_horizon_h.source: Open-Meteo forecast horizon used in practice is 7 days; we plan 36 h ahead

forecast_error_sd_c.source: assumption: typical day-ahead 2 m temperature RMSE at 24 h lead (MeteoSwiss verification order of magnitude)

forecast_trust.source: tuned on 2025 (sweep 0.7/0.8/0.9): planning on 70% of forecast heat sink gives fewest rejections AND misses (less over-commitment cascade)

dump_allowed.source: Reference house has no dry cooler: heat that cannot be stored must not be produced (zero-dump policy). Set true to model a dry cooler.
